install.ifa

Installation

Choose your installation method: GUI Installer, Script, or Cargo

GUI Installer (Recommended)

Download the cross-platform graphical installer for a guided installation experience.

Download Installer

Single executable that works on Windows, macOS, and Linux:

# Download from GitHub releases
https://github.com/AAEO04/ifa-lang/releases

# Run it:
# Windows: Double-click or run from PowerShell
# macOS/Linux: chmod +x ifa-installer && ./ifa-installer

The installer auto-detects your OS, checks system requirements (2GB RAM, 1GB disk), and installs the complete ifa CLI toolchain.

Headless / CLI Installation

For scripts and automation, use headless mode:

# Install with defaults (~/.ifa, add to PATH)
ifa-installer --headless

# Auto-accept all prompts
ifa-installer --headless --yes

# Install to custom directory
ifa-installer --headless --dir /opt/ifa

# Uninstall
ifa-installer --headless --uninstall

The installer downloads the latest release from GitHub, verifies SHA256 checksums, extracts to the target directory, and updates PATH.

Script Install

Windows (PowerShell)

irm https://github.com/AAEO04/ifa-lang/releases | iex

macOS / Linux

curl -sSf https://aaeo04.github.io/ifa_lang/install.sh | sh

Cargo (Rust Users)

Install from Crates.io

cargo install ifa-cli

From Source

Build from Git

# Clone the repository
git clone https://github.com/AAEO04/ifa-lang.git
cd ifa-lang

# Build release binary
cargo build --release

# Install CLI to system
cargo install --path crates/ifa-cli

# Build GUI Installer (optional)
cargo build --release -p ifa-installer-gui

Verify Installation

ifa --version
# Output: Ifá-Lang v1.x.x

ifa --help
# Shows all available commands

Editor Support

Syntax highlighting and LSP support:

  • VS Code: Search "Ifá-Lang" in Extensions
  • Vim/Neovim: Plug 'ifa-lang/ifa.vim'
  • Sublime Text: Package Control - Ifá-Lang
  • LSP: ifa lsp starts the language server
